an5.75:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an5.75:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco yodhājīvo rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ
an5.75:1.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ
an5.75:2.2: apica kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ
an5.75:2.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ
an5.75:3.2: apica kho ussāraṇaññeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ
an5.75:3.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno sokasmiṃ.
an5.75:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussāraṇaṃ
an5.75:4.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussāraṇaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ
an5.75:5.2: so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati
an5.75:5.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:5.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an5.75:6.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcime yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu
an5.75:6.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ
an5.75:6.7: amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatāti
an5.75:6.8: so taṃ sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ
an5.75:7.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ
an5.75:7.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ
an5.75:8.2: apica kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ
an5.75:8.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu naheva kho suṇāti
an5.75:8.6: amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatāti
an5.75:8.7: apica kho sāmaṃ passati itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgataṃ
an5.75:8.8: so taṃ disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ
an5.75:9.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ
an5.75:9.2: apica kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ
an5.75:9.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ
an5.75:10.2: apica kho ussāraṇaññeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ
an5.75:10.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ohasati ullapati ujjagghati upphaṇḍeti
an5.75:10.6: so mātugāmena ohasiyamāno ullapiyamāno ujjagghiyamāno upphaṇḍiyamāno saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ
an5.75:11.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ
an5.75:11.2: apica kho ussāraṇaññeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ
an5.75:11.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussāraṇaṃ
an5.75:12.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati
an5.75:12.5: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati
an5.75:13.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussāraṇaṃ apica kho sampahāre haññati byāpajjati
an5.75:13.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:14.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussāraṇaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati
an5.75:14.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati
an5.75:14.4: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno viniveṭhetvā vinimocetvā yenakāmaṃ pakkamati
an5.75:14.5: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
an5.75:15.1: so araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā
an5.75:15.2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti
an5.75:15.3: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
an5.75:15.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti
an5.75:15.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti
an5.75:15.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti
an5.75:15.7: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an5.75:16.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatupakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti
an5.75:16.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an5.75:16.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an5.75:16.4: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati
an5.75:16.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti
an5.75:17.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussāraṇaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati
an5.75:17.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:17.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsūti.
